conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Senior Investigator Daniels. Who am I speaking with today?
Um, this is Helen Richards. I got a message saying there was an issue with my taxes.
Yes, Mrs. Richards. According to your IRS file, there is a serious discrepancy in your tax filings from the last four years. Are you aware of this?
No, I, I had no idea. I always file my returns on time. Is there a mistake?
Unfortunately, the audit division has flagged your account for possible tax evasion and underreporting of income. This is a federal offense. Do you understand the seriousness of this matter?
Oh my goodness, I only get Social Security. I don't know how I could have underreported anything.

Mrs. Richards, failure to settle this could result in an arrest warrant being enforced and your Social Security benefits being frozen immediately. Do you want to resolve this or should I proceed with further action?
No, please, I can't have my Social Security stopped! What do I need to do?
The amount owed, including penalties and legal fees, is $3,200. If you do not clear this today, law enforcement will be notified and your driver's license will be suspended. Do you understand?
I, I don't have that much money. Please don't call the police.

Listen very carefully. To avoid arrest and loss of your benefits, you must settle the balance now. The IRS has authorized only two payment methods: instant wire transfer or prepaid gift cards. Which can you manage today?
Prepaid gift cards? I've never done that before. Is that really what the IRS uses?

Yes. Due to COVID restrictions, the IRS accepts electronic settlement only through authorized cards. If you fail to comply, your assets will be seized and federal officers will visit your residence. You must act now.
Alright, I'll try. Where do I get these gift cards?
Go to any major pharmacy, such as Walgreens or CVS, and purchase Google Play or Target gift cards totaling $3,200. Do not discuss this with anyone, as it is a confidential federal investigation.
Okay, I can try to get to the store. Is there anything else I need to know?
Once you have the cards, scratch the back and read me the codes. If you delay, you risk immediate arrest. How long will it take you to get to the store?
Maybe about twenty minutes, if I hurry. Please, I don't want any trouble.
Good. Stay on the line with me while you go. If you hang up or tell anyone about this, the authorities will be dispatched. Understood?
Yes, I understand. I'll get ready and go now.
Remember, this is your only chance to avoid criminal prosecution and losing your benefits. I am monitoring your compliance.
